The '''Battle of the Feather Nebula''' was a battle that occurred at the [[Feather Nebula/Legends|Feather Nebula]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] early in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] history. The battle was the subject of the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] ''[[The Charge at Feather Nebula]]''.
